concept_decisions: Keep concept negative impression and taper. Correct concept overly smooth leaflike outline and sparse veins: use denser small posteriorly curved modular grooves, each stopping at median line, with broad small anterior depression rather than invented shield anatomy. Reference Fig2I is straight and complete-looking, not holotypeA bent specimen or incompleteC/E/G; modest unequal margins are artistic simplification, not copied source mesh. Retain broken slab but lower concept thick miniature-plaque rim; fossil body lies below surrounding bedding surface with median ridge only relative to impression. Neutral artistic palette. No texture grain or copied photograph.
